svg.title: Gamma-Poisson update for the help desk call rate
svg.desc: The Gamma(3, 2) prior, the Poisson likelihood as a function of the rate, and the Gamma(50, 10) posterior on one axis of calls per hour.
svg.text: One shift updates a badly low prior
47 calls in 8 hours, so the observed rate is 5.875 calls per hour
The posterior mean 5.0 is 0.20 times the prior mean 1.5 plus 0.80 times the observed 5.875.
Eight hours of data outweigh a prior worth two hours by four to one, so the posterior sits beside
the data and only a little of the way back toward the prior.
